title: MusicDrop v1.5.4 Available
changelog:
• Fixed Mobile Layout & Spacing Bug: Resolved text-wrapping bug on narrow screen mobiles where the trending artists swipe badge wrapped vertically, eliminating the large empty space
• Silky Smooth Song Fade & Merge: Replaced the disruptive DJ overlap jump with a gentle, elegant volume fade-out over the final 2 seconds and a seamless fade-in for the next track
• Zero-Gap Playback: Next track starts smoothly with zero audible gap or abrupt song cut-offs
• Settings UI Update: Renamed transition setting to 'Seamless Merge & Crossfade (Zero-Gap)'
